population.survivorship: Frame series all end 2023 or later except 121 ended listings (2023-2026): VALIDATION contains no delisting; TEST forced exits at the last observed close (primary), bounds -100% and sourced cash consideration reported per candidate. Coverage of SEC 10-K filers 22% (2010) / 48% (2020).

returnBasis.benchmarks: PRICE_RETURN (SPY total return not used: no sourced dividend path in this strand; TR exists for 8 titles only)

investment: fully invested at target weights except market filter / exit rules; cash 0 %

multipleTesting.note: Primary: Holm within family over the weekly excess vs SPY (block bootstrap, 26 w). Secondary: Holm within family vs own-universe EW. Observed excess is not secured unless Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05.
